scope: 24 regional vehicle interpretations and geographic road fleet catalogs

checks.geometry: 24 source/runtime imports and hash pins verified; all under 20,000 triangles and 2 MiB runtime GLB
checks.controls: 25 tests: catalog plus mount, accelerate, steer, brake, reverse, stop and exit for all 24
checks.visual: Four exterior turntable views, lit three-quarter and exact driver-eye views inspected for each model
checks.reproducibility: Whole fleet generate-fleet.mjs --check passed for the reviewed generator hashes. Concurrent later generator edits require regeneration and renewed review; this report remains bound to the hashes above.
checks.geography: 14 city checks and fallback/coverage tests passed
checks.downloads: No-Range per-file download, byte cache eviction, shared cancellation and directory rehosting tests passed

limitations: Original polygonal interpretations, not manufacturer CAD; rounded body targets, simplified trim and interiors
Some regional profiles reuse export-market or different steering-side configurations; Korean peninsula profile primarily approximates South Korea
Display graphics and paint are illustrative; doors are static; game handling is not measured performance
No separate authored GLB LOD chain; distant instances use host proxies
